name: Terrer (Spain)
description: A hoist triangle of the bars of Aragon with its apex at the centre, the fly green with a central band of white and red stripes.
history: Municipal flag of Terrer; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle of yellow and red bars with its base at the hoist
bars on the triangle and central red stripe
central band of white and red stripes across the fly
